**Styregruppen for AFDK** (The Steering Committee for AFDK) is the professional governing body responsible for managing the [[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (AFDK) database, which operates under the [[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] (RKKP) [^src2] [^src6] [^src13]. The committee's primary significance lies in its authority to decide on the retention of clinical quality indicators and the establishment of national healthcare standards. For instance, the committee adopted the 50% standard for structured patient education (Indicator 8) and established a 90% target for [[antikoagulationsbehandling|antikoagulationsbehandling]] as good clinical practice [^src1] [^src6].

The committee is chaired by [[axel-brandes|Axel Brandes]] [^src15] [^src16] and comprises a diverse group of healthcare professionals, epidemiologists, and data managers from across Danish regions and hospitals. Notable medical members include [[ole-dyg-pedersen|Ole Dyg Pedersen]], [[dorthe-svenstrup|Dorthe Svenstrup]], [[ulla-davidsen|Ulla Davidsen]], and [[lars-frost|Lars Frost]] [^src15] [^src16]. Crucially, the committee integrates the patient perspective by including patient representatives such as [[inge-molgaard|Inge Mølgaard]] and [[robert-bedsted|Robert Bedsted]] [^src15] [^src16]. The committee actively collaborates with these [[afdk-patientrepraesentanter|Patientrepræsentanterne i AFDK]] to operationalize initiatives like patient education [^src1].

Styregruppen for AFDK governs and evaluates several key clinical indicators to drive quality improvement. For [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]], which tracks the incidence of ischemic stroke among atrial fibrillation patients, the committee set a standard and development target of ≤ 0.8 per 100 risk years based on current data and literature [^src5] [^src9]. For [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]], concerning [[thyreoideastimulerende-hormon-tsh|thyreoideastimulerende hormon (TSH)]] measurement at the time of diagnosis, the committee has identified systemic challenges with coding in [[labka|LABKA]] and data transfers, advocating for greater focus on screening newly diagnosed patients [^src7] [^src10] [^src11]. Furthermore, the committee issues recommendations for [[indikator-4b|Indikator 4b]], emphasizing the need for regular kidney function monitoring for patients on DOACs and recommending that this be explicitly noted in hospital discharge summaries [^src8] [^src12]. They have also conducted validation work on [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]] (echocardiography), revealing significant underreporting to the Landspatientregisteret [^src3] [^src14].

Looking toward the future, the committee is considering age-standardizing all outcome indicators due to demographic developments and an expected increase in intracranial hemorrhages [^src13]. They continuously audit and comment on the annual AFDK reports, ensuring that the transition from hospital-centered to population-based quality measurement across health clusters is rigorously evaluated [^src2] [^src6].

## Claims

### clinical-standard
- En 90% målopfyldelse for antikoagulationsbehandling er valgt som værende god klinisk praksis [^src1] (afdk-styregruppe)
  - **Page:** 4
  - **Source:** wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2024.pdf, pages 1-5

### standard
- Styregruppen har valgt at sætte en standard på ≤ 0,8 per 100 risiko år for Indikator 5 [^src1] (indikator-5, afdk-styregruppe)
  - **Page:** 49
  - **Source:** wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2024.pdf, pages 46-50

### result
- Standarden for Indikator 5 opfyldes i flertallet af regionerne og sundhedsklyngerne [^src1] (indikator-5, afdk-styregruppe)
  - **Page:** 49
  - **Source:** wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2024.pdf, pages 46-50

### policy-decision
- Styregruppen har valgt at anse en 90 % målopfyldelse for antikoagulationsbehandling som værende god klinisk praksis [^src1] (afdk-styregruppe, antikoagulationsbehandling)
  - **Page:** 4
  - **Source:** wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2025.pdf, pages 1-5

### policy-assessment
- Styregruppen vurderer, at der dels kan være udfordringer med forskellige koder for en TSH måling i LABKA og dels bør der sættes større fokus på at få målt TSH hos patienter med nydiagnosticeret atrieflimren [^src1] (afdk-styregruppe, indikator-3, labka, thyreoideastimulerende-hormon-tsh)
  - **Page:** 29
  - **Source:** wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2023.pdf, pages 26-30

### governance
- Styregruppen overvejer at alders-standardisere alle resultatindikatorer på grund af den demografisk udvikling [^src1] (afdk-styregruppe)
  - **Page:** 66
  - **Source:** wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2023.pdf, pages 66-70
